about_the_game:
Spectral Asylum: Echoes of The Forgotten pays homage to the original Slender The Eight Pages, and contains elements of Slender The Arrival alongside the Backrooms with its atmospheric locations and eerie notes for story telling.

The game takes place in an abandoned asylum, located in the [REDACTED]. A reality separate from our own. You play as Nia Varinian, a senior in high school who's parents run a well known pharmaceutical company known as Echo Corp. While Echo Corp is wildly praised for its break throughs in medical technology and creating new opportunities for its patients, it also houses a bit of a questionable background.

In recent times missing persons cases have emerged linking to the establishment, even Nia's parents, the owners have vanished.

it's up to you to find them and uncover the secrets behind Echo Corp.

What was supposed to be a year of looking forward to new beginnings, and a turning point for her battered relationship with her parents, has turned into what will be the most unforgettable nightmare she will ever have.

Survive the horrific entities that await, uncover the secrets of Echo Corp and the [REDACTED], and escape the madness in this spine chilling experience!
